title: Whimsical Fantasy Landscape
description: A vibrant cartoon-style fantasy landscape featuring a glowing purple crystal cliff with blue butterflies on the left, a treehouse beside a river with lily pads and a small boat, winding golden pathways leading up layered green and orange hills to a windmill and a ruined tower, connected by a colorful bridge and a large stone bridge in the background under a purple-pink sky with floating parchment papers.
